minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  January 14, 2020

  The Parking Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, January 14, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
  Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
  announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/Finance Authority Members/Parking
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority / Finance Authority / Parking Authority
  /Joint Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance Authority,
  Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on
  the Agenda.

  There was no response.

  PARKING AUTHORITY MINUTES.  It was moved by Finance Authority
  Member/Parking Authority Member/Joint Powers Authority Member Morales and
  seconded by Finance Authority Member/Parking Authority Member/Joint Power
  Authority Member Dotson, that the Minutes for the Finance Authority/Parking
  Authority/Joint Powers Authority Meeting held on December 10, 2019, be approved. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Finance Authority Members/Parking Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority
  Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Finance Authority Chairman
  Butts; and
  Noes: None.

125  AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO AGREEMENT NO. 18-118 APPROVED – MILLER
  BARONDESS, LLP. Staff report dated January 14, 2020, was presented recommending
  approval of Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. 18-118 with Miller Barondess, LLP for
  broad ranging legal advice, guidance and representation to increase the hourly rate for
  attorney services from $550/hour to $650/hour, paralegal services from $150/hour to
  $250/hour, and add a “most favored nation” clause.

  1
 January 14, 2020

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Parking Authority
  Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Parking
  Authority Member Dotson that the City Council/Successor Agency/Parking Authority
  does hereby approve Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. 18-118 with Miller Barondess,
  LLP. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Parking Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Parking Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Parking Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned in memory of Roland Johnson, 30 year resident, and
  Arrick “Dobby” Turner, employee of the City of Inglewood for over 30 years, at the hour
  of 2:23 p.m.

  Approved this 28th day of a January 2020.

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
